title: Codebase changes plugin: log, banner and browser
asked: Add another banner to the console's load listing all new builds: every time Claude is asked to build, edit or remove something, create an entry with details about what it does, broken into steps, and store its results. Show them in a Codebase changes banner on every load until closed (closed everywhere). Keep a permanent log in the console. One plugin, installed; all data stored on axHub.

steps.text: Record format change-log@1 and validators (Node + Python)
Server routes and storage on axHub
CLI, local queue and Claude Code hook
Banner, log browser and settings sub-tab

result.summary: New console plugin: every build/edit/remove/fix request is a change-log@1 entry opened by a Claude Code hook and filled in step by step; stored one file per entry on axHub (changes/ in the shared data folder); banner on every load until closed (closed everywhere); permanent log under Builds -> Codebase changes. Not pushed: waits for review on branch feat/codebase-changes.
